tools.name: search_conditions
tools.description: Search VA disability conditions by name. Returns condition summaries with permanent VBD IDs. 1 credit per successful call.

tools.name: get_condition
tools.description: Full condition record by slug: rating levels, exam topics, evidence checklists, citations, provenance. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_diagnostic_code
tools.description: Diagnostic code record with linked condition and rating levels. 1 credit.

tools.name: search_forms
tools.description: Search the VA forms catalog by number or title. Reference material, no charge.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: VA form record with official links, revision dates, and PDF hash. Reference material, no charge.

tools.name: get_state_benefits
tools.description: State veteran benefit guide by two letter code, optionally one category (for example property_tax). 2 credits.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Fuzzy match free text (misspellings ok, for example 'tinitus' or 'form 526') to canonical VBD IDs with confidence scores. 2 credits.

tools.name: source_check
tools.description: Checks whether a general VA benefits statement or topic is supported by Veteran Benefit Desk's developer tier source linked educational corpus (conditions, diagnostic codes, VA forms, state benefits). Returns a verdict (supported, partially_supported, unsupported, outdated, unverifiable, or abstain)

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, credits used, and credits remaining this month. Free.
